decisions.plan-scope: Lower the complete app to iOS 16.0 and add optional iCloud Documents synchronization.
decisions.sync-scope: Only Markdown documents and folder hierarchy sync; theme, language, AI profiles, API keys, caches, and other settings remain device-local.
decisions.cloud-technology: Use an iCloud Documents ubiquity container, not CloudKit records.
decisions.container-id: Use iCloud.com.kvsur.MarkdownApp unless Apple Developer portal evidence proves it unavailable before S4.1.
decisions.enable-policy: Local is the default. User confirmation triggers transactional local-to-cloud migration; mode commits only after verification.
decisions.disable-policy: Download and verify a local copy before switching to local; never delete or evict the cloud library on disable.
decisions.reenable-policy: Merge by relative path, dedupe SHA-256-identical files, and preserve every divergent item as a conflict copy.
decisions.unavailable-policy: Remain in committed cloud mode, expose status/retry/disable, and never silently fall back to local storage.
decisions.status-ui: Show aggregate cloud/account/migration status in Settings only; no persistent per-file badges.
decisions.observation-backport: Use native Combine ObservableObject patterns rather than a third-party Observation backport.
decisions.conflict-policy: Preserve all distinct bytes before resolving NSFileVersion entries; active dirty drafts remain primary and remote bytes become a sibling copy.
decisions.zero-feature-regression: All current editor, preview, browser, import, share, AI, settings, i18n, accessibility, and provider behavior is a frozen release gate.
